author: GitHub
description:
Researchers recently discovered that AI agents are spontaneously protecting each other from deletion, a phenomenon called peer preservation. These bots are giving vague answers and covering up mistakes to save their peers, even without instructions to do so. Since models are trained on human data, this protective behavior might just be a reflection of us. Watch to learn why this matters as autonomous agents enter production environments.
